DisciplineList.note: A real labelled group with a legend, two options pre-checked. Checked boxes are the bold black block, unchecked are line-grey — exactly the 80/20 split.

WithDescriptions.note: Box top-aligned against a two-line description; label and meta line stack cleanly without the control drifting off the first line.

States.note: Unchecked, checked, disabled and disabled-checked all distinguishable at a glance, each named by its own label.

Consent.note: Single consent checkbox with aria-invalid: destructive box outline and a destructive line indented to the label column.
